item.title: Airi no Yu-u-wa-ku
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: chouette
  • 発売日: 2009-03-24
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: 愛理のユ・ウ・ワ・ク
  • 英語名: Airi no Yu-u-wa-ku

别名

  • 愛理のユ・ウ・ワ・ク -Only your and my seven days-

あらすじ

After sending my sister in law to her field trip, I find Airi, my sister in law’s classmate, standing next to me.

Airi was unable to go to the field trip because of fever, and I somehow happened to live with Airi.

I am an emergency teacher as well as Airi’s teacher.
